lines.en: label chinamispring4:
scene senseichinamibathtime1
Here I sit in shrink wrap, left alone to rot. To suffocate and die before I’m stuffed into a pot.
lines.zh: 我坐在这儿，裹着收缩膜，被丢下任其腐烂。在被塞进锅子之前窒息而死。

lines.en: Today, my bones will be the soup. My skin will be the broth. My hair will be the garnish and my cum will be the froth-
lines.zh: 今天，我的骨头会是汤。我的皮肤会是汤底。我的头发会是配菜，而我的精液会是浮沫——

lines.en: That coats the throats of goats and lambs, they’ll feed me to the farm. But I’ve yet to please the FDA, so there’s a chance I might bring harm-
lines.zh: 那层浮沫会覆上山羊和羔羊的喉咙，他们会把我喂给农场。可我还没能让 FDA 满意，所以我有可能带来危害——

lines.en: Disease/a plague/a parasite - the maddest of all cows. Never once have I been human, never once have I been proud.
lines.zh: 疾病／瘟疫／寄生虫——所有牛中最疯的那一头。我从未当过人，也从未骄傲过。

lines.en: To be what she has made of me. Ingredients, at best. A specimen — this mess I’m in won’t ever let me rest.
lines.zh: 成为她把我变成的东西。往好了说，是配料。一个标本——我陷在这么一团糟里，永远不得安息。

lines.en: Howdy.
lines.zh: 你好呀。

lines.en: You’ll never guess where I am right now.
lines.zh: 你绝对猜不到我现在在哪儿。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime2
: Papa?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime3
: Aren’t you going to come into the bath with Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你不进来和 Chinami 一起洗澡吗？

lines.en: : No.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because this is already a step further than I planned on going today.
lines.zh: : 因为这已经比我今天打算做的要多走一步了。

lines.en: : Several steps, actually. So you’ll just have to deal with me looking away until you’re ready to come out.
lines.zh: : 实际上是好几步。所以在你洗好出来之前，你就只能忍着我转过头去不看。

lines.en: : But Chinami’s arms! They’re not bendy enough!
lines.zh: : 可是 Chinami 的手！它们不够弯！

lines.en: : Then neither are mine.
lines.zh: : 那我的也不够弯。

lines.en: We’re here. And I haven’t done anything wrong. At least not yet.
lines.zh: 我们到这儿了。而我还没做错任何事。至少目前还没有。

lines.en: But the fact that I {i}am{/i} here means that I {i}could.{/i} That I {i}might.{/i} That I {i}want{/i} to. But I don’t {i}want{/i} to {i}want{/i} to. So I {i}want{/i} to stop wanting that.
lines.zh: 但我{i}在{/i}这儿这个事实意味着我{i}可能会{/i}。意味着我{i}或许会{/i}。意味着我{i}想{/i}。可我并不{i}想{/i}去{i}想{/i}。所以{i}我{/i}想停止那种渴望。

lines.en: What {i}I{/i} want rarely seems to matter at all anymore, though. At least not when there are creatures who do and don’t exist pulling me into places where they know that I’ll get lost.
lines.zh: 不过{i}我{/i}想要什么，似乎早就越来越无关紧要了。至少当那些存在又不存在的生物把我拖进她们明知我会迷失的地方时，就不重要了。

lines.en: This is one of those places — a battle I’ve already returned from once. But it feels more like a suicide mission when I need to face it alone this time.
lines.zh: 这里就是其中一个地方——一场我已经从中归来的战斗。但这一次需要我独自面对时，感觉更像是一次自杀式任务。

lines.en: It’s innocent enough. And for anyone worth more than me, I’m sure it would be fine. It’d be like being sent out to take down a single spider with a barrel full of dynamite.
lines.zh: 它本身足够单纯。对任何比我更有价值的人来说，我敢肯定都没问题。那就像被派去用一整桶炸药干掉一只蜘蛛。

lines.en: But someone lit my hands on fire a long, long time ago. And now I can’t carry anything without the risk of burning or igniting it.
lines.zh: 可很久很久以前，有人把我的手点着了。而现在，我拿起任何东西都有烧毁或者点燃它的风险。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime4
: Is Papa only uncomfortable because Chinami is a girl?
lines.zh: : 爸爸觉得不自在，只是因为 Chinami 是个女孩吗？

lines.en: : One day, Chinami’s going to stop asking questions I don’t know how to answer without incriminating myself.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，Chinami 会停止问那些我不知道该怎么回答才不会把自己定罪的问题。

lines.en: : She probably won’t. Chinami is a curious girl. There are all sorts of things she wants to learn more about.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。Chinami 是个好奇的女孩。她想深入了解的事情有各种各样的。

lines.en: : One day, Chinami will {i}also{/i} stop saying things that incriminate {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 总有一天，Chinami{i}也{/i}会停止说那些会把{i}她{/i}自己定罪的话。

lines.en: : Is it wrong for Chinami to think about love sometimes?
lines.zh: : Chinami 有时候想想恋爱的事，是错的吗？

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime5
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : That’s what Papa was fighting about with Chinami’s big sisters, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 爸爸之前就是在为这个跟 Chinami 的姐姐们吵架，对吧？

lines.en: : Big sis Chika has been talking in her sleep again. She says that you love more than one person. Was she mad because you love big sis Yumi too?
lines.zh: : 姐姐 Chika 又说梦话了。她说你爱的不止一个人。她生气是因为你也爱 Yumi 姐姐吗？

lines.en: : I don’t {i}love{/i} Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我并不{i}爱{/i} Yumi。

lines.en: : You just want to do naughty stuff with her then?
lines.zh: : 那你只是想跟她做那些下流的事咯？

lines.en: : Wha- why is that a thing you even know about?
lines.zh: : 什——你怎么会知道这种事？

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime6
: Chinami watched Game of Thrones, remember? And even if big sis Chika closed her eyes for the naughty parts, Chinami knows they exist.
lines.zh: : Chinami 看过《权力的游戏》啊，记得吗？就算 Chika 姐姐在那些下流的片段闭上眼睛，Chinami 也知道它们是存在的。

lines.en: : Has Papa been doing naughty things with big sis Yumi?
lines.zh: : 爸爸有和 Yumi 姐姐做过下流的事吗？

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} Now, change the subject.
lines.zh: : {i}没有。{/i}现在，换个话题。

lines.en: : But he’s been doing naughty things with big sis Chika, right?
lines.zh: : 但他和 Chika 姐姐做过下流的事，对吧？

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime7
: I can’t talk about this with you.
lines.zh: : 这个我没法跟你谈。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re too young. And your sister would kill me.
lines.zh: : 因为你太小了。而且你姐姐会杀了我。

lines.en: : I don’t think she would, Papa. People are allowed to do naughty things together when they love each other.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不会的，爸爸。两个人相爱的时候，是可以一起做下流的事的。

lines.en: : And since you love big sis Chika, Chinami is okay with you doing as many naughty things as you like!
lines.zh: : 既然你爱 Chika 姐姐，那你爱做多少下流的事，Chinami 都同意！

lines.en: : Shut up...
lines.zh: : 闭嘴……

lines.en: : But she doesn’t really understand how those naughty things work yet since her eyes are always closed. So she hopes that someone will-
lines.zh: : 不过她其实还不太明白那些下流的事是怎么运作的，因为她总是闭着眼睛。所以她希望有谁能——

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime8
: Shut up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime6
: Oh no! Talking about naughty stuff made Papa mad at Chinami again!
lines.zh: : 糟了！聊下流的事又把爸爸惹生气了！

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime9
: Chinami is sorry. She just wants to understand and all of this stuff is super confusing to her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 很抱歉。她只是想弄明白，而这一切对她来说超级难懂。

lines.en: : I’m not...{i}mad.{/i} You don’t know any better yet. But if this is something you really want to learn about, you should talk to your sister. Not me.
lines.zh: : 我没有……{i}生气{/i}。你还不懂事。但如果这真是你想了解的东西，你应该去跟你姐姐谈。不是跟我。

lines.en: : But if Chinami talks to big sis Chika about that, she’ll get sad that Chinami is growing up. So Chinami needs to stay Chinami. That’s what’s best for everyone right now.
lines.zh: : 可如果 Chinami 跟 Chika 姐姐谈这个，她会因为 Chinami 长大了而难过。所以 Chinami 得一直当 Chinami。现在这样对大家都最好。

lines.en: : Yeah well, Chinami’s clearly not smart enough to know what’s best for {i}anyone{/i} right now if she’s going to put herself into situations like this.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那 Chinami 显然还不够聪明，根本不知道现在对{i}任何人{/i}什么最好——如果她非要把自己弄进这种局面的话。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime10
: Does Papa think Chinami has ulterior motives?
lines.zh: : 爸爸觉得 Chinami 有别的目的吗？

lines.en: : He thinks Chinami should stop referring to herself in third person before bringing up serious topics like this.
lines.zh: : 他觉得 Chinami 在提起这么严肃的话题之前，应该先别再用第三人称称呼自己。

lines.en: : Chinami will do that so long as Papa promises to keep it a secret.
lines.zh: : 只要爸爸答应保密，Chinami 就会这么做。

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. This whole {i}day{/i} should be kept a secret as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便。在我看来，这一{i}整天{/i}都该保密。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime11
: Which sister do you like more then? Is onee-chan right that she’s winning? Or do you like delinquent girls like Yumi more?
lines.zh: : 那你更喜欢哪个姐姐？onee-chan 说她赢了，是真的吗？还是你更喜欢 Yumi 那种不良少女？

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime12
: Or maybe {i}I’m{/i} your type and that’s why you’re afraid to get in the bath with me.
lines.zh: : 又或者{i}我{/i}才是你喜欢的类型，所以你才不敢跟我一起进浴缸。

lines.en: : If I had to choose between all three of you...Chika would come out on top.
lines.zh: : 如果我非要在你们三个里选一个……赢的会是 Chika。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime13
: Mm. That’s the right answer. She loves you the most, after all.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这是正确答案。毕竟她最爱你。

lines.en: : But Chinami doesn’t-
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 并不——

lines.en: : You’re doing it again.
lines.zh: : 你又来了。

lines.en: : Oh. Sorry. Habit.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉。习惯了。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime14
: What I don’t understand is why onee-chan would be so sad if you loved Yumi the way you love her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不明白的是，如果你爱 Yumi 的方式跟爱她一样，onee-chan 为什么会那么伤心。

lines.en: : How is that a thing you’re confused about? You watch TV. You play games. You practically live on your phone. I’m sure you know {i}all{/i} about the conventional definition of “love” by now.
lines.zh: : 这有什么好困惑的？你看电视。你打游戏。你几乎就住在手机里。我敢肯定你现在对「爱」的常规定义已经{i}了如指掌{/i}了。

lines.en: : But there’s conflicting information everywhere, Papa! Everybody has an opinion on what kind of love is “wrong” and what kind of love is “right.”
lines.zh: : 可到处都是互相矛盾的信息啊，爸爸！每个人都对什么样的爱是「错」的、什么样的爱是「对」的有自己的看法。

lines.en: : And that’s the part that’s confusing to me because I’m hearing from the same people who say those things that love is different for everyone. So why do some people get to choose what’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 而让我困惑的就是这一点，因为我从说这些话的同一些人嘴里听到：爱对每个人来说都不一样。那为什么有些人就能裁定什么是错的？

lines.en: : Like...maybe relationships are just all about two people with the same definition of love finding each other? Does that make any sense?
lines.zh: : 比如说……也许恋爱关系就只是两个对爱有着相同定义的人找到彼此？这说得通吗？

lines.en: : I think you just answered your own question.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你刚刚就回答了你自己的问题。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime15
: Hm?
: Your sister’s upset because she believed we had the same definition. And I told her the last time I came over that we didn’t.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐难过，是因为她以为我们的定义是一样的。而我上次来的时候告诉过她，我们不一样。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime16
: Oohhhhhhh, okay. I think I get it now. You’re like Jaime Lannister. And Chika is Cersei Lannister and Yumi is Brienne of Tarth.
lines.zh: : 哦————好吧。我想我懂了。你就像 Jaime Lannister。而 Chika 是 Cersei Lannister，Yumi 是 Brienne of Tarth。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you just said.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你刚说了什么。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime17
: Cersei and Brienne both love Jaime and Jaime loves both of them, but his love for Cersei outweighs his feelings for Brienne, so he always goes back to {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : Cersei 和 Brienne 都爱 Jaime，Jaime 也爱她们两个，但他对 Cersei 的爱超过了他对 Brienne 的感情，所以他总是回到{i}她{/i}身边。

lines.en: : But then that makes {i}Brienne{/i} sad because she never gets a chance to act on her feelings — which leaves {i}Jaime{/i} with the feeling of longing until-
lines.zh: : 可那又让{i}Brienne{/i}伤心，因为她从来没有机会付诸行动——而{i}Jaime{/i}则一直带着那种渴望，直到——

lines.en: : Are you going to watch it? Because I don’t want to spoil what happens if you’re going to watch it.
lines.zh: : 你打算看吗？因为如果你打算看，我可不想剧透。

lines.en: : Probably not, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 大概不会，Chinami。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna spoil it anyway just to be safe. Chika says spoilers are bad. But the gist is that love triangles always make somebody upset and you’re the tip of your own triangle.
lines.zh: : 反正为了保险我也不会剧透。Chika 说剧透很讨厌。不过重点是，三角恋总会让某个人伤心，而你自己就是那个三角的顶点。

lines.en: : That’s fair. I should just probably also mention that triangle is situated neatly inside a shape with so many sides that I’m not even sure if there’s a name for it.
lines.zh: : 说得也对。不过我大概也该提一句：那个三角被整整齐齐地嵌在一个边数多到我都不确定有没有名字的图形里。

lines.en: : Then, is Chika winning {i}that{/i} competition too? Or just the tinier triangle with her and Yumi in it?
lines.zh: : 那 Chika 在{i}那场{/i}比赛里也赢了吗？还是只在那个有她和 Yumi 的更小的三角里赢了？

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime18
: Chinami won’t tell on you if that’s what you’re worried about. She’s an expert at gossip now.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心的是这个，Chinami 不会去告状的。她现在可是八卦专家了。

lines.en: : But clearly not an expert at maintaining a regular speech pattern.
lines.zh: : 但显然不是维持正常说话方式的专家。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime19
: Okay, {i}you{/i} try spending your entire life talking in third person and then having to switch for an entire conversation. It’s harder than it sounds, Papa.
lines.zh: : 好啊，那{i}你{/i}试试看一辈子都用第三人称说话，然后再在整段对话里换过来。这比听起来难多了，爸爸。

lines.en: : Can you call me Akira instead? That’s my actual name.
lines.zh: : 你能不能叫我 Akira？那才是我的真名。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime20
: No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : That was a pretty instantaneous rejection. May I ask {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 这拒绝可真够迅速的。我能问{i}为什么{/i}吗？

lines.en: : How come you’re allowed to ask “why?” but I get in trouble whenever I do it?
lines.zh: : 为什么你就能问「为什么」，而我每次问都要挨骂？

lines.en: : Because I do it when I genuinely want to know something and you do it for the sole purpose of annoying me.
lines.zh: : 因为我是真的想知道某件事才问，而你问的唯一目的就是惹我烦。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime21
: That’s what daughters are for! Probably. I’ve never had a dad, so I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 女儿就是干这个的！大概吧。我从来没有过爸爸，所以其实不太清楚。

lines.en: : You’re a weird girl, Chinami. But surprisingly bearable when you’re not persuading me to do things I’m uncomfortable with.
lines.zh: : 你是个古怪的女孩，Chinami。但只要你没在劝我做那些让我不自在的事，倒是意外地好相处。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime22
: Thank you! Does that mean you’ll get in the bath with me now?
lines.zh: : 谢谢你！那是不是意味着你现在愿意跟我一起进浴缸了？

lines.en: : Did you listen to my last sentence at all? Or did you just stop after the part where I called you bearable?
lines.zh: : 我最后那句话你到底有没有听？还是说我夸你好相处那部分之后你就没往下听了？

lines.en: : I was listening. I just think you’re making too big of a deal out of being uncomfortable and I want help washing my hair.
lines.zh: : 我有在听。我只是觉得你把「不自在」这件事看得太重了，而我需要有人帮我洗头。

lines.en: : I’m in my 30’s. I’m not getting into the bath with a little girl no matter {i}how{/i} much she wants me to.
lines.zh: : 我都三十多岁了。不管一个{i}小女孩{/i}有多想要，我都不会跟她一起进浴缸。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime23
: Then Chinami will just assume that Papa is a lolicon and that he wants to do naughty things to her while her sister is away at work. Papa is a bad boy.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 就当爸爸是个萝莉控，想在她姐姐上班不在家的时候对她做下流的事好了。爸爸是个坏男孩。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime24
: Kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime25
: Wow. You really {i}are{/i} uncomfortable, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你{i}真的{/i}很不自在啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : I’m not proud of it, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我并不为此自豪，Chinami。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be like this.
lines.zh: : 我不想变成这样。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime26
: Then Chinami will switch back to {i}regular{/i} Chinami so it’s easier for Papa to remember his role as Papa and not her sister’s lolicon boyfriend!
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 就变回{i}普通{/i}的 Chinami，好让爸爸更容易记住自己是爸爸的身份，而不是她姐姐的萝莉控男朋友！

lines.en: : Where did you even learn that word?
lines.zh: : 你到底是从哪儿学来这个词的？

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi accidentally taught Chinami {i}lots{/i} of bad words. But Chinami isn’t going to use them right now because Papa’s in a pickle!
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐不小心教了 Chinami{i}好多{/i}脏话。不过 Chinami 现在不会用的，因为爸爸正左右为难呢！

lines.en: : I think I’m going to head back out into the living room now.
lines.zh: : 我想我还是回客厅去吧。

lines.en: : No! Papa is going to wash Chinami’s hair because Chinami is sick and he needs to do what she commands of him.
lines.zh: : 不行！爸爸要给 Chinami 洗头，因为 Chinami 生病了，而他必须照她说的做。

lines.en: : I’m not getting into the bath with you. It’s not happening.
lines.zh: : 我不会跟你进浴缸的。这不可能发生。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime27
: Then stay out there.
lines.zh: : 那就待在外面吧。

lines.en: : Chinami will come close to you.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 就靠近你一点。

lines.en: scene black
scene senseichinamibathtime28
: Nihihihi~
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻嘻~

lines.en: : Chinami knew it was only a matter of time until Papa caved. Now, she gets to enjoy a nice scalp massage while he fights his inner demons!
lines.zh: : Chinami 就知道爸爸迟早会妥协的。现在，她可以享受舒服的头皮按摩，而他则跟自己的心魔搏斗！

lines.en: : Right now, those demons are telling me to drown you in the bathtub.
lines.zh: : 此时此刻，那些心魔正在叫我把你按进浴缸里淹死。

lines.en: : But then you’d never get to see the grown up Chinami who won’t make you feel bad for wanting to do naughty things.
lines.zh: : 可那样你就永远看不到长大后的 Chinami 了，那个不会让你因为想做下流的事而难过的 Chinami。

lines.en: : You’d still be my “girlfriend’s” sister either way. Which means that any feelings I {i}ever{/i} have involving you won’t be good ones.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，你都还是我「女朋友」的妹妹。也就是说，我{i}任何时候{/i}对你产生的感情都不会是好的感情。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime29
: Does that mean you’ll be my Papa forever, then?
lines.zh: : 那这是不是意味着你会永远是 Chinami 的爸爸？

lines.en: : That’s what it means if you’re still with big sis Chika many years from now, right?
lines.zh: : 如果很多年以后你还跟 Chika 姐姐在一起，就是这个意思吧？

lines.en: : Will Papa get jealous if Chinami ever gets a boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 交了男朋友，爸爸会吃醋吗？

lines.en: : Will he try to scare them away in order to protect her?
lines.zh: : 他会为了保护她而把人家吓跑吗？

lines.en: : Or will Chinami have to stay single forever so Papa won’t be sad?
lines.zh: : 还是说 Chinami 得一辈子单身，好让爸爸不难过？

lines.en: : Don’t look up at me like that, please.
lines.zh: : 别那样抬头看着我，拜托。

lines.en: : Why not? I’m having a cute moment with my daddy. It’s not {i}my{/i} fault he’s a lolicon.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？我正跟我爸爸享受可爱的时刻呢。他是萝莉控又{i}不{/i}是{i}我{/i}的错。

lines.en: : Well, you’re certainly not helping.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你可一点忙都没帮上。

lines.en: : Is there any way Chinami {i}can{/i} help?
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami{i}有{/i}什么能帮上忙的吗？

lines.en: : Yes. By not capitalizing on my weaknesses and coercing me into doing things like this.
lines.zh: : 有。别再利用我的弱点、逼我做这种事就行。

lines.en: : Chinami learned from her friend Tsukasa that capitalizing on someone’s weakness is the quickest way to get what you want.
lines.zh: : Chinami 从她的朋友 Tsukasa 那儿学到，利用别人的弱点是得到你想要的东西最快的方法。

lines.en: : I knew that girl was going to be a bad influence on you.
lines.zh: : 我就知道那女孩会对你产生坏影响。

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime28
: Maybe next time, all three of us can take a bath together and {i}really{/i} put Papa in a tight spot!
lines.zh: : 也许下次我们三个一起洗澡，{i}真正{/i}把爸爸逼到绝境！

lines.en: : Now I {i}really{/i} want to drown you.
lines.zh: : 现在我{i}真{/i}想把你淹死了。

lines.en: : Chinamiiii!~ I’m home early!~
lines.zh: : Chinamiiii！~ 我回来早啦！~

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime30
: Oh. You’re-
: Welcome home, big sis Chika!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 姐姐！

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime31
: Are you...
lines.zh: : 你在……

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : Are you...washing her hair?
lines.zh: : 你在……给她洗头？

lines.en: : She made me do it. I tried to stay out there. But she just kept-
lines.zh: : 她逼我的。我试着待在外面。可她一直——

lines.en: scene senseichinamibathtime32
: KYAAAAAAAAH! OHMYGOD! THIS IS THE CUTEST THING I’VE EVER SEEN IN MY LIFE! IT’S LIKE WE’RE AN ACTUAL FAMILY! OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD!
lines.zh: : 呀————！我的天哪！这是我这辈子见过最可爱的画面！我们就像真正的一家人！我的天哪我的天哪我的天哪！

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene senseichinamibathtime33
: LET ME GRAB A CHANGE OF CLOTHES AND I’LL GET IN THE BATH TOO! OHMYGOD! I’M SO IN LOVE!
lines.zh: : 我去拿套换洗的衣服，我也进浴缸！我的天哪！我太幸福了！

lines.en: scene black
: Do you think big sis Chika is a lolicon too?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Chika 姐姐也是萝莉控吗？

lines.en: : I think you should never repeat that word in front of her for as long as you live.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你这辈子都别在她面前再说那个词。

lines.en: I bail out before Chika makes it into the bathroom again.
lines.zh: 我在 Chika 再次进浴室之前溜了出来。

lines.en: Just being in there with Chinami was hard enough. And knowing who I am, I...I’m not sure if I’d be able to handle {i}both{/i} of them at once.
lines.zh: 光是跟 Chinami 待在里面就已经够难熬了。而我知道自己是什么人，我……我不确定自己能不能同时应付她们{i}两个{/i}。

lines.en: Regardless, it seems like my job here is done.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，看来我在这儿的任务完成了。

lines.en: Chinami will survive for at least one more day.
lines.zh: Chinami 至少还能再活一天。

lines.en: And I-
lines.zh: 而我——

lines.en: And I will go to sleep undeserving of the same.
lines.zh: 而我会带着不配拥有同样的东西的心情入睡。
